title: Vijayan hails students' protest at Sanskrit University

ai.summary: Veteran CPI leader Pinarayi Vijayan praised Sanskrit University students' protest against college suspensions, calling it a defense of educational rights and urging public support for such movements.

facts.claim: students of Sanskrit University in Kalady
facts.quote: students of the Sanskrit University in Kalady

facts.claim: protesting against suspension of 16 college mates for over two months
facts.quote: protesting against the suspension of 16 of their college mates for over two months

facts.claim: called off agitation after Kerala High Court allowed suspended students to write semester exams
facts.quote: called off the agitation after the Kerala High Court allowed the suspended students to write their semester exams

facts.claim: Vijayan accused current UDF government of handing over education to private sector and Sangh Parivar
facts.quote: accused the current UDF government of "handing over" education to the private sector and the Sangh Parivar

facts.claim: Vijayan linked student protests to Koothuparamba firing incident
facts.quote: Koothuparamba Martyrs' Day reminds us of the history of the resistance raised by the Left against the moves to commercialise the education sector

ai.background_note: Students at Sanskrit University in Kalady protested against suspensions of 16 peers for over two months, ending after Kerala High Court permitted them to take semester exams.
